outcome: ultrasound characteristics of decidualized non-ovarian endometriotic lesions
cohort: The cohort consisted of 13 pregnant women with a surgical or sonographic diagnosis of endometriosis made prior to conception, who had non-ovarian endometriotic lesions and attended postpartum examination.
finding: Decidualization was observed in 54% of women with non-ovarian endometriotic lesion(s) and resolved after delivery, with decidualized lesions showing a significant reduction in maximum diameter postpartum compared to during pregnancy.
